meta.title: Devlog: August 16, 2026 - August 23, 2026
meta.description: continued work on overdue-task accountability, consequence challenges, and a sharper reminder experience.

bullets.text: continued work on clearer overdue-task visibility and accountability when deadlines pass.
expanded the consequence flow with motion-based and persistence-based challenges for missed tasks.
refined reminder, lockout, and mascot messaging so the app's personality stays consistent across the experience.

summary.text: i spent this week making the overdue loop feel more complete, from the moment a task slips through to the work needed to get back on track. still very much in progress, but it is becoming harder for a missed deadline to quietly disappear into the void.
